rule: Exploratory event illustration: earliest C_select init with all 16 reference target frames and observed-R growth >3 at any station; existing analysis event threshold; not selected by forecast/GHI error or gain
AGRI_display: fixed C03/C02/C01 false colour, square-root stretch 0..0.7, same transform for every tile
GHI: right-ending 15-minute means; 3-seed means for plotting only; missing kept as gaps
reference: same-fold R(actual future AGRI), not independent truth or deployable input
